svg.title: Formify system design
svg.desc: In the visitor's browser, a page built with React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS sends jobs to a Web Worker, which runs MediaPipe and ONNX Runtime Web on WebAssembly; a service worker keeps the app and its models for offline use. Vercel serves the static files and one function that counts pictures in Upstash Redis. GitHub deploys to Vercel.
svg.text: Everything that touches a photo runs in the browser. The server only serves files and keeps a count.
The photo and the result never leave this box.
